name: 64870 · Webb City, MO
findings: ZIP 64870 (Webb City) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64870 (Webb City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
